summary: Frontend verification of Reel Scout landing page fixes (v2.6.15). Verified: (1) 'What you get back' dark strip bullets now readable with text-slate-100 (rgb(241,245,249)) on slate-900 bg (rgb(15,23,42)). (2) Inline scroll-to sign-in section removed; replaced by compact 'Ready when you are' CTA banner + footer. (3) All three signin triggers (topnav, hero, CTA) open the same shadcn Dialog with data-testid='signin-dialog'. Dialog contains gradient logo, title, subtitle, email (autofocused), password, and submit button — all testids present. Login with mydatejar@gmail.com / #Test1234 succeeds and redirects to Dashboard. Escape key closes the dialog.
